newsitem.title: THAILAND: First Bangkok City Bank in $150 million debt issue.
newsitem.headline: First Bangkok City Bank in $150 million debt issue.

text.p: First Bangkok City Bank Plc said on Wednesday it will issue subordinated debentures worth $150 million or the equivalent in other currencies.
In a statement to the Stock Exchange of Thailand, the bank said it would issue the debt, which will have a maximum term of 10 years, exclusively to foreign investors.
The issue is part of the bank's $1 billion dollar global medium term note programme, the statement said.

The bank's board has decided to pay holders of common shares a dividend of 1.70 baht per share for the six month period to 31 December 1996. Holders of preferred shares will receive 20 baht per share, the statement said.
The bank has also decided to purchase a riverside site in central Bangkok from affiliate Pan Inter (warehouse) Co Ltd on which the bank will locate its new headquarters, it added.
The bank will spend 608 million baht ($23.4 million) acquiring the site.
